VECTOR NAV — Operating Procedures Robot Startup Procedure 1. Ensure the robot is fully charged (battery above 80% for full shift operation). 2. Power on the Jetson Orin Nano by pressing the power button. 3. Wait for the ROS2 system to initialize — approximately 30 seconds. 4. The robot will announce "VECTOR NAV ready" via its speaker when fully initialized. 5. Perform a test movement by saying "move forward slightly" to confirm motor response. Robot Shutdown Procedure 1. Say "return to charging station" to send the robot home before shutdown. 2. Wait until the robot confirms it has docked at the charging station. 3. Say "shutdown" or press the physical power button for 3 seconds. 4. The robot will save its current map and state before powering off. Navigation Commands - To navigate to a location, say: "Go to [location name]" or "Navigate to [location name]" or "Take me to [location name]" - To stop the robot, say: "Stop", "Halt", or "Cancel navigation" - To ask where the robot is, say: "Where are you?" or "What is your current location?" - To return home, say: "Go to charging station" or "Return to base" Docking Procedure 1. The robot uses AprilTag markers for precision docking. 2. When within 2 meters of a tagged location, the vision system activates. 3. The robot aligns itself with the AprilTag and approaches slowly at 0.1 m/s. 4. Docking is confirmed when the robot announces the location name. 5. If docking fails, the robot retreats 0.5m and retries up to 3 times. Emergency Procedures - In case of emergency, say "Emergency stop" or press the red physical button on the robot. - The robot will stop all motion immediately and announce its current location. - To clear an emergency stop, say "Resume" after the area is safe. - If the robot is blocking an emergency exit, manually push it away — it has a manual override mode. - Contact the control room immediately if the robot malfunctions. Battery Management - The robot monitors its battery continuously. - Below 30%: The robot will warn the user verbally. - Below 20%: The robot will automatically return to the charging station. - Below 10%: The robot will stop in place and request manual intervention. - Always plug in the robot at the end of each shift. Obstacle Handling - The robot uses its RPLidar A1M8 to detect obstacles. - If an obstacle is detected, the robot will stop and announce "Obstacle detected". - The robot will attempt to re-plan its path automatically. - If re-planning fails 3 times, the robot will ask for help verbally. - Never place objects within 0.5m of the robot's planned path.

Text to Speech: Piper TTS for verbal responses - Vision: AprilTag detection for precision docking, scene classification for location verification Navigation - SLAM: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping using RPLidar - Path Planning: Nav2 stack with obstacle avoidance - Precision Docking: AprilTag-guided final approach - The robot can navigate to any pre-mapped location by name What VECTOR NAV Can Do - Navigate autonomously to named locations in the warehouse - Answer questions about warehouse locations, procedures, and operations - Dock precisely at any AprilTag-marked station - Detect and avoid obstacles in real-time - Operate fully offline without internet connection - Respond to natural language voice commands in English What VECTOR NAV Cannot Do - Navigate in unmapped areas — it requires a pre-built map - Carry loads heavier than 5 kg - Climb stairs or traverse rough outdoor terrain - Operate in multi-robot coordination scenarios - Connect to the internet or use cloud services - Understand languages other than English (current version)
